title: Warnings lead ticks cast i32->u64 before the >0 fail-fast: a negative value wraps to ~2^64 and defeats the 'leads > 0' rule
detail: jint returns i32; u64(-5) wraps to 18446744073709551611 and passes the ==0 check, so the spec's 'Fail-fast validation: ... leads > 0' is bypassable. In warnings.odin:236-240 the wrapped lead makes window_start collapse to 0, so forecast rows appear from tick 0 and the UI reads a ~2^64 lead — the 30s telegraph inverts.
recommended_fix: Validate each lead as i32 (reject < 0 or > i32 max) BEFORE the u64 cast, mirroring the set-piece guard (mult/st/dt/fl), or use jint_strict plus an explicit >0 check.

title: Partial warnings block: missing node_amber_pct/pipe_amber_pct default to 0, pass the ladder check, and make every healthy node/pipe permanently Amber
detail: With node_amber_pct omitted (default 0) and node_red_pct 90, the ladder check passes (0 < 90 <= 100); strain_level(0, 0, 90) returns .Amber for a 0% healthy node, so every alive node/pipe raises Warning_Raised at tick 1 — a degenerate ladder slips the fail-fast.
recommended_fix: Require explicit presence of all seven warnings fields (or amber >= 1) so a missing-field default of 0 cannot satisfy the ladder invariant.
